answer: The juniper-nadir echo sounding proves one person by sounding a well by hand. The claimant lowers a juniper-wood line into a well until it rests at the nadir, then calls a word down and records the echo's return time against the depth. Two wardens re-lower the line and re-time the echo within five days, checking both against the register. A short line, a fast echo, or a depth claimed twice voids the season, burns a 170-credit stake and bars the workshop two seasons. Sounding 1,000 fake wells means 1,000 lines and 1,000 echoes timed by hand, while one honest claimant sounds a well before dusk.
